expectations.text: The plan contains at least 2 explored approaches with pros/cons

claims.claim: Only FingerprintFileRepository has caching among the three repositories
claims.evidence: Transcript Agent 1: 'Grep search for existing cache code confirmed only FingerprintFileRepository has caching'. Plan Context confirms 'TemplateDiffsFileRepository and TemplateRulesFileRepository have no caching'.

Transcript Agent 2: 'FingerprintFileRepository does NOT extend BaseJsonFileRepository, so base-class approach would not cover all repos uniformly — reinforces per-concrete-class approach'. This claim is critical to the approach selection and is corroborated in the plan Approach 2 rejection.

claims.claim: create_test_position_index and create_test_metadata factory helpers exist in the test file
claims.evidence: Transcript Agent 2 mentions these as reusable, but we did not verify the actual test files. The claim is plausible given the existing test patterns, but cannot be confirmed without reading the test files.

suggestions.reason: No assertion checks that the two concrete repository class names (TemplateDiffsFileRepository and TemplateRulesFileRepository) are actually mentioned by name in the plan. A plan for a generic 'add caching' task that only describes one of the two repos would pass all current assertions.

suggestions.assertion: Exploration found and referenced the actual existing repository class in the codebase
suggestions.reason: This assertion is satisfied by finding FingerprintFileRepository, but a stronger check would verify it also found TemplateDiffsFileRepository and TemplateRulesFileRepository — the classes being modified — not just the reference pattern.

eval_feedback.overall: All 9 assertions pass. Evals are well-targeted for this scope. The two gaps are: (1) no check that both target repository classes are named specifically, (2) exploration verification only checks the pattern class, not the classes to be modified.
